opportunities.name: Two-city time difference and holiday check, then email sync note
opportunities.description: Compare two cities on timeanddate Time Zone Converter, look up holidays for the later city's country, then compose a 'Sync' email to ops with the offset and dates to avoid.
steps: Open timeanddate Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Search and add city B and read hour offset
Select city B's country and view its holidays
Open the mail New message form
Enter recipient, subject 'Sync: A / B, Month', and body with offset and dates to avoid

instances.values: New York / Berlin, Germany, December, ops@example.com, 6 hours, avoid Dec 25 and 26
London / Sydney, Australia, January, ops@example.com, 10 hours, avoid Jan 1 and 26
